The fog is rolling in and the screams are already real. 🩸💀

Arrietty — fresh off RuPaul's Drag Race Season 17 — is touching down on Azúcar's Main Floor, bringing the sickest local talent in town with her. This isn't a show, it's a haunting. Expect spooky, expect sexy, expect full-blown chaos from the first number. 🕷️✨

Mark it, set alarms, tell everybody — Scream Queens is the one Halloween night you don't want to sleep on.
